questions.question: Discuss the role of a Ground Tour Operator.
questions.solution_html:
• A Ground Tour Operator manages travel services at the destination. Their roles include
  • • Arranging local transport and accommodation
  • • Organizing sightseeing and guides
  • • Assisting tourists during the tour
  • • Coordinating with travel agencies and hotels
  • They ensure smooth operation of tours at the local level.
questions.final_answer: They ensure smooth operation of tours at the local level.

questions.question: Write a short note on passport-size photographs required for visa.
questions.solution_html:

  • must follow specific embassy guidelines regarding size, background color, facial expression, and recent
  • appearance. Incorrect photographs may lead to rejection or delay of visa processing.
